answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose secret is tied to their Semaphore identity. Each message carries an RLN proof and a rate-limit nullifier; publishing twice under the same epoch and nullifier exposes two distinct Shamir shares, allowing the private key to be reconstructed and verified. The contract can then slash the bonded collateral immediately, making Sybil identities costly rather than merely pseudonymous. A sparrow in a haven or on the tundra faces the same rule.
